caption:
The clocks went back this weekend, and I'm treating that extra hour like a gift.

Darker evenings are the perfect excuse to slow down and reset. Here's my one-hour autumn reset, step by step.

What would you do with one extra hour this week?

#autumnreset #productivity #slowliving #selfcare #routine #amsterdamlife

✦ AI-generated creator

slides.heading: Clear one surface
slides.body: Not the whole house. Just your desk or your nightstand. A calm space makes a calm mind.

slides.heading: Look at your week
slides.body: Write down the three things that truly matter. Everything else is a bonus.

slides.heading: Set an evening cut-off
slides.body: Pick a time your laptop closes. Darker evenings are made for rest, not for inboxes.

slides.title: Save this for Sunday
slides.body: Your future self will thank you.
